messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Buspirone is an anti-anxiety medicine.
Buspirone affects chemicals in the brain.
These chemicals may be unbalanced in people with anxiety.
Buspirone is used to treat symptoms of anxiety.
These symptoms include fear, tension, and irritability.
These symptoms also include dizziness and pounding heartbeat.
Other physical symptoms are also treated.
Buspirone is not an anti-psychotic medication.
It should not be used in place of medication prescribed by your doctor for psychotic disorders.
Triplet: ["chemicals in the brain", "may be unbalanced in", "people with anxiety"]

The relation 'may be unbalanced in' in the triplet is defined as 'The object entity is a group of individuals in which the subject entity might be in a state of imbalance.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
B. 'can be targeted by': The object entity is at risk of being misused or exploited by the subject entity.
C. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'contribute to': The subject entity plays a role in the development or occurrence of the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
